
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/swizard/p/19327334" title="发布于 2025-12-09 16:35">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">极限瘦身：将 Python AI 应用从 100MB 砍到 30MB</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p data-path-to-node="1">上一篇我们用“钞能力”（Chaquopy + Paddle）快速搞定了功能，但代价是惨痛的——APK 体积可能飙升到了 <strong>100MB+</strong>。这在用户眼里就是“毒瘤软件”。</p>
<p data-path-to-node="2">今天，我们不仅要当“大厨”，还要当“外科医生”。我们将对这个 APK 进行一场<strong>精准的瘦身手术</strong>，目标是将体积压缩到 <strong>30MB 以内</strong>，同时保留 Python 的开发体验。</p>
<h2 data-path-to-node="5">1. 诊断报告：为什么它这么“胖”？</h2>
<p data-path-to-node="6">在动刀之前，我们先得知道脂肪堆积在哪里。一个典型的 Chaquopy + Paddle APK 结构如下：</p>
<ul data-path-to-node="7">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="7,0,0"><strong>Android 基础代码</strong>：&lt; 5MB（忽略不计）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="7,1,0"><strong>Python 解释器 + 标准库</strong>：~10MB（这是基础开销）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="7,2,0"><strong>Native 库 (.so 文件)</strong>：<strong>~80MB+ (罪魁祸首)</strong> 🚨</p>
<ul data-path-to-node="7,2,1">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="7,2,1,0,0">PaddlePaddle 包含了完整的训练框架、反向传播逻辑、多种硬件驱动……但你在手机上只需要<strong>推理（Inference）</strong>。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-path-to-node="8"><strong>手术方案</strong>：</p>
<ol start="1" data-path-to-node="9">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="9,0,0"><strong>切除多余肢体</strong>：只保留一种 CPU 架构。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="9,1,0"><strong>更换核心引擎</strong>：用轻量级的 <strong>ONNX Runtime</strong> 替换笨重的 PaddlePaddle 库，但依然使用 Paddle 训练的模型。</p>
</li>
</ol><hr data-path-to-node="10">
<h2 data-path-to-node="11">2. 第一刀：ABI 架构过滤 (减重 50%)</h2>
<p data-path-to-node="12">Android 手机 CPU 有多种架构（x86, armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a）。默认情况下，Gradle 会把所有架构的 .so 库都打包进去，就像你出门旅行带了春夏秋冬四季的衣服。</p>
<p data-path-to-node="13">但在 2024 年，<strong>99% 的主流手机都是 <code>arm64-v8a</code></strong>。</p>
<h3 data-path-to-node="14">🛠 操作指南</h3>
<p data-path-to-node="15">修改 <code>app/build.gradle</code>：</p>
<div class="code-block ng-tns-c4195179700-67 ng-animate-disabled ng-trigger ng-trigger-codeBlockRevealAnimation" data-hveid="0" data-ved="0CAAQhtANahcKEwjN56jri7CRAxUAAAAAHQAAAAAQJw">
<div class="code-block-decoration header-formatted gds-title-s ng-tns-c4195179700-67 ng-star-inserted"><span class="ng-tns-c4195179700-67"><span class="ng-tns-c4195179700-67">Groovy</span></span>
<div class="buttons ng-tns-c4195179700-67 ng-star-inserted">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div class="formatted-code-block-internal-container ng-tns-c4195179700-67">
<div class="animated-opacity ng-tns-c4195179700-67">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">android {
    defaultConfig {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ...</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        ndk {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ✂️ 咔嚓！只保留 64位 ARM 架构
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 这会直接丢弃 x86 和 32位 ARM 的库文件</span>
            abiFilters "arm64-v8a"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        }
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<blockquote data-path-to-node="17">
<p data-path-to-node="17,0"><strong>效果</strong>：如果你的 APK 里原本包含三套 .so 文件，这一步直接能让体积减少 <strong>2/3</strong>。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr data-path-to-node="18">
<h2 data-path-to-node="19">3. 第二刀：引擎置换手术 (减重核心)</h2>
<p data-path-to-node="20">这是最关键的一步。<code>pip install paddlepaddle</code> 安装的是一个通用型巨无霸。</p>
<p data-path-to-node="21"><strong>核心思路</strong>：</p>
<ul data-path-to-node="22">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="22,0,0"><strong>训练时</strong>：在电脑上用 PaddlePaddle（功能全，体积大）。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="22,1,0"><strong>部署时</strong>：在手机上用 <strong>ONNX Runtime</strong>（专注推理，体积极小）。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-path-to-node="23"><strong>ONNX (Open Neural Network Exchange)</strong> 是 AI 界的“通用货币”。所有的模型（PyTorch, TensorFlow, Paddle）都可以转换成 ONNX 格式，然后用同一个轻量级引擎运行。</p>
<h3 data-path-to-node="24">步骤 A：模型转换 (在电脑上操作)</h3>
<p data-path-to-node="25">首先，把你的 Paddle 模型转换成 <code>.onnx</code> 文件。百度贴心地提供了 <code>paddle2onnx</code> 工具。</p>
<div class="code-block ng-tns-c4195179700-68 ng-animate-disabled ng-trigger ng-trigger-codeBlockRevealAnimation" data-hveid="0" data-ved="0CAAQhtANahcKEwjN56jri7CRAxUAAAAAHQAAAAAQKA">
<div class="code-block-decoration header-formatted gds-title-s ng-tns-c4195179700-68 ng-star-inserted"><span class="ng-tns-c4195179700-68"><span class="ng-tns-c4195179700-68">Bash</span></span>
<div class="buttons ng-tns-c4195179700-68 ng-star-inserted">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div class="formatted-code-block-internal-container ng-tns-c4195179700-68">
<div class="animated-opacity ng-tns-c4195179700-68">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre># <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 安装转换工具
pip </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> paddle2onnx

# </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 转换模型 (假设你的模型存放在 inference_model 文件夹)
paddle2onnx </span>--model_dir ./<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">inference_model \
            </span>--<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">model_filename model.pdmodel \
            </span>--<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">params_filename model.pdiparams \
            </span>--<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">save_file mobile_model.onnx \
            </span>--opset_version <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">11</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-path-to-node="27">现在你得到了一个通用的 <code>mobile_model.onnx</code>。</p>
<h3 data-path-to-node="28">步骤 B：修改 Gradle 依赖 (Android端)</h3>
<p data-path-to-node="29">修改 <code>app/build.gradle</code> 的 Python 配置，把巨大的 paddle 换成小巧的 onnxruntime。</p>
<div class="code-block ng-tns-c4195179700-69 ng-animate-disabled ng-trigger ng-trigger-codeBlockRevealAnimation" data-hveid="0" data-ved="0CAAQhtANahcKEwjN56jri7CRAxUAAAAAHQAAAAAQKQ">
<div class="code-block-decoration header-formatted gds-title-s ng-tns-c4195179700-69 ng-star-inserted"><span class="ng-tns-c4195179700-69"><span class="ng-tns-c4195179700-69">Groovy</span></span>
<div class="buttons ng-tns-c4195179700-69 ng-star-inserted">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div class="formatted-code-block-internal-container ng-tns-c4195179700-69">
<div class="animated-opacity ng-tns-c4195179700-69">
<pre class="ng-tns-c4195179700-69"><code class="code-container formatted ng-tns-c4195179700-69" data-test-id="code-content">defaultConfig {
    python {
        pip {
            <span class="hljs-comment">// ❌ 移除这个巨无霸
            <span class="hljs-comment">// install "paddlepaddle==2.5.0" 
            
            <span class="hljs-comment">// ✅ 换成这个轻量级选手 (约 5-8MB)
            install <span class="hljs-string">"onnxruntime" 
            install <span class="hljs-string">"numpy"
        }
    }
}
</span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<h3 data-path-to-node="31">步骤 C：重写 Python 推理代码</h3>
<p data-path-to-node="32">我们需要修改 <code>ai_engine.py</code>，把 Paddle 的调用换成 ONNX Runtime 的调用。逻辑几乎一样，只是 API 变了。</p>
<div class="code-block ng-tns-c4195179700-70 ng-animate-disabled ng-trigger ng-trigger-codeBlockRevealAnimation" data-hveid="0" data-ved="0CAAQhtANahcKEwjN56jri7CRAxUAAAAAHQAAAAAQKg">
<div class="code-block-decoration header-formatted gds-title-s ng-tns-c4195179700-70 ng-star-inserted"><span class="ng-tns-c4195179700-70"><span class="ng-tns-c4195179700-70">Python</span></span>
<div class="buttons ng-tns-c4195179700-70 ng-star-inserted">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div class="formatted-code-block-internal-container ng-tns-c4195179700-70">
<div class="animated-opacity ng-tns-c4195179700-70">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> src/main/python/ai_engine.py</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> numpy as np
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> onnxruntime as ort
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> os.path <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dirname, join

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AIModel:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__init__</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(self):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取模型路径 (假设你把 onnx 文件放在了 src/main/python 目录下)</span>
        model_path = join(dirname(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__file__</span>), <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mobile_model.onnx</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化 ONNX 推理会话</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">这是最耗时的步骤，建议在后台线程做</span>
        self.session =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ort.InferenceSession(model_path)
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取输入层名称 (就像知道插座的形状)</span>
        self.input_name =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.session.get_inputs()[0].name

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> predict(self, input_data):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 数据预处理 (和之前一样，转为 numpy)</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 注意：ONNX 对数据类型要求很严，必须匹配模型定义 (通常是 float32)</span>
        data = np.array([[float(input_data)]], dtype=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">np.float32)
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 执行推理</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> run(输出节点名列表, 输入字典)</span>
        result =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.session.run(None, {self.input_name: data})
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 解析结果</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> result 是一个列表，取出第一个输出</span>
        raw_val =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> result[0][0][0] 
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ONNX 极速推理结果: {raw_val:.2f}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<hr data-path-to-node="34">
<h2 data-path-to-node="35">4. 进阶深潜：压榨最后 1MB</h2>
<p data-path-to-node="36">如果你对体积有极致的强迫症，这里还有两个“黑魔法”：</p>
<h3 data-path-to-node="37">技巧 1：移除 Python 标准库中的废物</h3>
<p data-path-to-node="38">Chaquopy 默认会打包完整的 Python 标准库（包括你根本用不到的 <code>email</code>, <code>html</code>, <code>multiprocessing</code> 等模块）。</p>
<p data-path-to-node="39">在 <code>build.gradle</code> 中可以配置剔除：</p>
<div class="code-block ng-tns-c4195179700-71 ng-animate-disabled ng-trigger ng-trigger-codeBlockRevealAnimation" data-hveid="0" data-ved="0CAAQhtANahcKEwjN56jri7CRAxUAAAAAHQAAAAAQKw">
<div class="code-block-decoration header-formatted gds-title-s ng-tns-c4195179700-71 ng-star-inserted"><span class="ng-tns-c4195179700-71"><span class="ng-tns-c4195179700-71">Groovy</span></span>
<div class="buttons ng-tns-c4195179700-71 ng-star-inserted">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div class="formatted-code-block-internal-container ng-tns-c4195179700-71">
<div class="animated-opacity ng-tns-c4195179700-71">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">python {
    </span>//<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ...
    pyc {
        </span>//<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 编译成 pyc 字节码，加载更快，体积更小
        src false 
    }
    </span>//<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 剔除不需要的标准库模块
    extractPackages </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">json</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">os</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sys</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> //<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 仅举例，慎用
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-path-to-node="41"><em>注意：通过 <code>buildPython</code> 自定义 Python 构建来剔除标准库比较复杂，通常对于新手，开启 <code>.pyc</code> 编译已经能节省不少空间。</em></p>
<h3 data-path-to-node="42">技巧 2：动态加载模型</h3>
<p data-path-to-node="43">不要把 <code>.onnx</code> 模型文件打包在 APK 的 <code>assets</code> 或 <code>python</code> 目录里。</p>
<ul data-path-to-node="44">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="44,0,0"><strong>做法</strong>：APK 里只放代码。用户第一次打开 App 时，从你的服务器下载模型文件到手机本地目录。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="44,1,0"><strong>收益</strong>：APK 体积瞬间减少 5MB - 50MB（取决于模型大小）。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-path-to-node="45">

</tr>
</tbody>

<hr data-path-to-node="48">
<h2 data-path-to-node="49">🏁 总结</h2>
<p>要让 Python AI 应用在 Android 上兼顾开发效率和落地体验，核心逻辑是：</p>
<p>“Python 写逻辑，ONNX 做引擎，Gradle 砍架构。”</p>
<ol start="1" data-path-to-node="51">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="51,0,0"><strong>ABI Filter</strong> 是必须的。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="51,1,0"><strong>Paddle/PyTorch/TF</strong> 只是训练工具，不要把它们带进 APK。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="51,2,0"><strong>ONNX Runtime</strong> 是端侧部署的最佳伴侣。</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 data-path-to-node="52">🚀 Next Step</h3>
<p>现在你的 App 既聪明又轻盈。但还有一个问题：安全性。</p>
<p>你的 Python 代码和模型文件在 APK 里几乎是“裸奔”的，黑客解压 APK 就能拿到你的核心算法。</p>
